Northwood High Staff

BENARD MORGAN

The Approachable Principal & Student Advocate.

  • Role: Principal
  • Location: Northwood High
  • Alias: Bernard (Not Mr. Morgan)
  • Specialty: Student Protection

Unlike many strict, bureaucratic high school administrators, Bernard Morgan insists that students and staff alike call him by his first name. This warmth and approachability make him a deeply trusted figure within Northwood High. He takes the time to truly know his students, prioritizing their well-being above policy.

The Protector

Bernard has developed a strong, protective relationship with Matt Miller, taking the time to seamlessly learn Matt's non-verbal cues. When Matt is in distress, Bernard provides a safe, authoritative sanctuary.

He possesses an ironclad sense of authority when students are threatened or exploited. When Courtney Evans attempted to corner and solicit Matt in the hallway, Bernard was the one Matt trusted to handle the situation. Bernard’s reaction to the violation of Matt’s boundaries was one of absolute fury, swiftly ensuring Matt's safety while initiating severe disciplinary action against Courtney.

A Safe Harbor

Because Bernard operates primarily on trust rather than fear, he acts as an essential "safe harbor" within the chaotic environment of Northwood High. Students who might otherwise fall through the cracks or be targeted by peers know that they can walk into his office without an appointment and be met with genuine support.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
